notes.title: Get Ready for a New Solitaire Adventure "Solitaire Quest: Love Blossoms"! 🌸
notes.content:
🌟 The time has come! In just a couple of weeks, the second game in our hit series will be released. Welcome "Solitaire Quest: Love Blossoms" a solitaire game now featuring hidden object locations! 🌸 But the main highlight? A captivating love triangle! And that’s not all the game has to offer.

We love our players and truly listen to your feedback, so this game includes all the improvements and features you've asked for since the release of our first game, "Solitaire Quest: Garden Story." In the new game, you can expect:

- 200 stunning and vibrant solitaire levels
- Hidden object levels with various mechanics
- A hidden gnome in the solitaire levels
- Decorating your own flower shop
- A bright and unpredictable love story

Love, adventure, the ocean, and captivating solitaire levels are waiting for you! 🌺🌴💖

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3147890/Solitaire_Quest_Love_Blossoms/?beta=1

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 🌟 Be a Part of the Design - Influence Our Solitaire Game's Destiny! 🌟
notes.content:
🌟 Dear Players! We're excited to announce that our studio is embarking on a [b]new Solitaire project[/b]. However, we're faced with a [b]delightful dilemma[/b] – we can't quite decide on the additional gameplay element for the game.

We'd love to hear your thoughts on what you'd prefer. You can choose one option from the list below or even suggest your own! It's crucial for us that our upcoming game resonates with you, which is why we're eager to consider your input when it comes to selecting the extra mechanic.

[b]The additional mechanic options are:[/b]

1. Hidden Object 
2. Puzzle
3. Merge Mechanic
4. Your Own Variant ːsteamhappyː

Your advice means the world to us! 🎉 Please share your insights below. 🚀
